Definition: an emptying place, e.g. an ash-heap
BiblicalUsage: The bullock of the sin offering is carried outside the camp to the place where the ashes are poured out, and there it is burned.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ash heap outside the camp is where sin is taken, and I am glad it is not inside.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
